dog.description_text: Meet Snoop Dog — New Arrival! Snoop Dog just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/GRP_NYC_Foster/IQAgvBW4X3AOSI73vqUMLoWnAZkOm7xhdJ3RDPQkR3lklZg?e=sukixY Snoop Dog is a 1 year old mixed breed male. His foster says "Once he started warming up he was definitely more high energy. Very good about not jumping on people and though he did hump once or twice, he stopped doing that quickly. outside, he does not pull the leash and very rarely barks at other people or animals. he is so friendly and so cuddly even though he’s kind of hype energy he’s really good at matching individual vibes so when he sees us kind of relaxing and watching TV, he just cuddles up right next to you on the couch if he sees you start to play or if you kind of gets the vibe that you guys are going for a walk he will start getting hyper. He’s just really good at matching your vibe. if you’re sitting down or laying down, he will just come up right next to you in like a small little ball. He also just follows you around , really good at taking commands to stay ,if he is kind of in your way like for example cooking or using the restroom." He is playful and affectionate. He has been neutered, microchipped, vaccinated, and had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
